name: web-dev
description: Web development on a modern React stack (React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Effect 4, TanStack Query 5, React Hook Form 7, shadcn/ui): one entry point, /web-dev:develop, that inspects the repository, picks the workflow (new project, existing project, one feature or API) and runs the skills for project setup, feature development, API integration and UI development.
